title: John Lennon and Yoko Ono attend New Year party at Mercer Arts Center, New York City | 1972
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono attended a New Year’s Eve party at the Mercer Arts Center in New York City on 31 December 1972.

The event was billed as “1973: The Endless Party”. It began at 11pm and ended in the small hours of New Year’s Day. Tickets cost $5 in advance and $7.50 at the door.

The headline act was The New York Dolls, with support from The Modern Lovers, Queen Elizabeth, Eric Emerson, and Ruby and The Rednecks. The Dolls played three sets, with the last taking place at 4am.

Also in attendance, though not performing, was Alice Cooper, whom Lennon befriended during the Lost Weekend between 1973 and early 1975.
